problems.title: Cancel a cube difference with its factors
problems.question: Simplify $\frac{\sqrt a}{a\sqrt a-27}(1+3/\sqrt a+9/a)(1-3/\sqrt a)$ and evaluate at a=1/19.
steps: After cancellation it is 1/t²=1/a, with a>0,a≠9.

problems.title: Two independent substitutions give four pairs
problems.question: Solve (x+y)²-4(x+y)=45 and (x-y)²-2(x-y)=3.
problems.idea: Solve for u=x+y and v=x-y separately.
steps: All four combinations are allowed. Convert them back to x,y.

problems.title: A reciprocal expression becomes a quadratic
problems.question: Solve 3(x²/9+16/x²)=10(x/3-4/x).
steps: The equation becomes 3t²-10t+8=0, giving t=2 or 4/3.
For t=4/3, x²-4x-12=0 gives x=6,-2. All are nonzero and valid.

problems.title: Follow the harmonic-mean definition actually given
problems.question: Positive a,b have geometric mean 4 and arithmetic mean A. The source defines H=1/(1/a+1/b). Find √(AH).
problems.idea: The supplied H is half the conventional harmonic mean.
problems.note: With the standard harmonic mean 2/(1/a+1/b), the answer would instead be 4. The source explicitly omits that factor 2, so both conventions must be distinguished.

problems.title: An equation for scaled roots
problems.question: ax²+bx+c=0 has distinct roots x₁,x₂. Write an equation whose roots are ax₁,ax₂.
problems.idea: Use the new sum and product.
steps: A monic quadratic with roots r,s is t²-(r+s)t+rs=0.
Insert the new sum and product.

problems.title: Recover distance from an averaging-time difference
problems.question: One car drives equal halves of a route at 108,72 km/h. Another drives equal halves of its time at those speeds and arrives 12 minutes earlier. Find the route length.
problems.idea: Write each total time in terms of distance D.

problems.title: Similar triangles with a shared angle
problems.question: D∈AC,AD=1,CD=3 and ABD=ACB. Find AB.
problems.idea: Triangles ABD and ACB are similar by two angles.
steps: The angle at A is shared, and the given other angles match.

problems.title: Incircle tangent pieces in a rhombus
problems.question: The incircle splits each rhombus side into lengths 8 and 2. Find the sine of its acute angle.
problems.idea: Adjacent tangent lengths multiply to the inradius squared.
steps: The side is s=8+2=10 and r=√(8·2)=4.

problems.title: Equal chords give equal exterior half-angles
problems.question: ABCD is cyclic with CA=CD. Prove BC bisects the exterior angle adjacent to ABD.
problems.idea: Use the equal base angles of triangle ACD.
formulas: Let CAD=CDA=t; equal inscribed angles subtend the same chord.
steps: Thus the angle between BC and the ray opposite BA is t, equal to CBD.
BC therefore halves the adjacent exterior angle.
problems.answer: The required exterior angle is bisected.

problems.title: An isosceles triangle with a midpoint median
problems.question: In trapezoid ABCD, the bisector of acute A meets CD at its midpoint P and the extension of short base BC at K. Prove BPK=90°.
problems.idea: Use the parallel bases to make ABK isosceles.
formulas: AD∥BK; A-bisector gives BAK=AKB; a median to the base of an isosceles triangle is perpendicular to it.
steps: P lies halfway between the parallel bases, because it is the midpoint of CD. Since A,P,K are collinear, AP=PK.
BP is therefore the median to base AK of isosceles ABK, hence BP⊥AK.
